settings.heading: Pure shilajit from the Himalayas
settings.lead: At Xomoashro, we offer pure shilajit sourced from the peaks of the Himalayas: a natural resin valued for centuries in traditional wellness.

settings.heading: Born in Chitral and Gilgit-Baltistan
settings.text:
Xomoashro was created in the Himalayan regions of Chitral and Gilgit-Baltistan to bring Pakistan the pure, authentic shilajit our mountains are known for.

When we found that much of the shilajit on the market was fake or diluted, we set out to offer a trusted alternative.

By working directly with ethical local collectors, we deliver shilajit that is pure, safe and honest, exactly as nature intended. Today, customers across Pakistan trust Xomoashro for real Himalayan shilajit.

settings.heading: Rediscover health through Himalayan shilajit
settings.text:
We believe everyone deserves a healthy, energised and balanced life. Shilajit, known locally as salajeet, is a natural mineral resin collected high in the Himalayas, with deep roots in Ayurvedic tradition.

Our mission is to reconnect people with this traditional resin, so it can become part of a daily routine inspired by ancient wisdom and modern well-being.
